name: PTR character copy: .ptr copy duplicates the player's own character once
contract: A player copies their own character from the source realm's characters schema with .ptr copy <name> (src/server/coa/CoAPtrCharacterCopy.cpp, PlayerDump). The copy is a new character on the same account that carries the inventory and its own Personal Bank; player mail it holds comes from the copy itself, so returning it cannot reach an unrelated character here; a name already taken here is renamed at login. A character keeps at most one live copy, and a player cannot copy a character of another account or an unknown name. ptr_character_copy uses this realm's own schema as the source.
